name: Hospital da Luz (Luz Saude)
verdict: Owned by Luz Saude, controlled by Fidelidade (84.99% Fosun International, 15% state-owned Caixa Geral de Depositos). Nothing found.
note: Portuguese private hospital group (Luz Saude: 60% Fidelidade / 40% Macquarie since Jan 2026; Fidelidade is 84.99% Fosun / 15% state-owned CGD). Front or sleeve sponsor at several clubs in 2026-27.
